definitions.explanation: Energy emitted in the form of waves or particles, especially ionizing radiation such as alpha rays, beta rays, and gamma rays. A significant topic in Japan due to its nuclear history.

examples.japanese: {放射線|ほうしゃせん}を{浴|あ}びないように{注意|ちゅうい}する。
examples.english: Take care not to be exposed to radiation.

examples.japanese: レントゲンは{放射線|ほうしゃせん}を{使|つか}って{体|からだ}の{中|なか}を{撮影|さつえい}する。
examples.english: X-rays use radiation to photograph the inside of the body.

examples.japanese: {放射線|ほうしゃせん}の{量|りょう}が{基準値|きじゅんち}を{超|こ}えていないか、{定期的|ていきてき}に{測定|そくてい}している。
examples.english: We regularly measure whether radiation levels exceed the standard values.

notes:
USAGE:
{放射線|ほうしゃせん} is a scientific term that is widely known in everyday Japanese, especially after the 2011 Fukushima nuclear disaster. It appears frequently in news, health, and science contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {放射線|ほうしゃせん}を{浴|あ}びる (to be exposed to radiation)
- {放射線|ほうしゃせん}{治療|ちりょう} (radiation therapy)
- {放射線|ほうしゃせん}{量|りょう} (radiation dose)
- {放射線|ほうしゃせん}{技師|ぎし} (radiological technologist)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {放射線|ほうしゃせん}: radiation (the rays/energy emitted)
- {放射能|ほうしゃのう}: radioactivity (the property of emitting radiation)
- {放射性物質|ほうしゃせいぶっしつ}: radioactive material (the substance itself)
